results.quote: Under the proposed optimization framework, we successfully verified the 27-Queens problem in just 28.4 days using eight RTX 5090 GPUs, thereby confirming the correctness of Preußer’s computational results.

results.previous_best: over two decades (estimated for leading CUDA implementation [7])
results.quote: Moreover, we have reduced the projected solving time for the next open case--the 28-Queens problem--to approximately 11 months, making its resolution computationally feasible.
For the 26-queens problem, we successfully calculated the number of solutions under 8 RTX 5090 GPUs in 2.5 days.

results.bound: over 10× speedup on 8 A100 GPUs and over 26× acceleration on 8 RTX 5090 GPUs compared to [7]
results.previous_best: 16 hours on 8 NVIDIA A100 GPUs (DoubleSweep-Light from [7])
results.quote: Notably, compared with the state-of-the-art CUDA implementation [7], our solution achieves over 10× performance improvement for the 24-queens problem under same configuration(8 A100 GPUs), and achieves over 26× performance improvement under 8 RTX 5090 GPUs.
